_INSTRUKCJA.deleteIntervalDays: How often to run cleanup in days (7 = once per week)
_INSTRUKCJA.deleteMessagesOlderThanDays: Delete messages older than X days (0 = all matched messages)
_INSTRUKCJA.cronSchedule: CRON schedule, for example every Sunday at 03:00
_INSTRUKCJA.channels: List of channels handled by AutoClean
_INSTRUKCJA.ownerIds: Optional owner ID fallback when OWNER_IDS is not set in env
_INSTRUKCJA.logChannelId: Optional log channel ID, leave empty to disable
_INSTRUKCJA.deleteLimit: Max messages deleted in one run (0 = no limit)
_INSTRUKCJA.dryRun: Test mode, log actions but do not delete messages

notifyBeforeDelete.message: Warning: messages in this channel will be cleaned in {minutes} minutes.
